<script
  is:inline
  set:html={`
    (() => {
      if (window.__officeCalcBound) return;
      window.__officeCalcBound = true;
      var setCell = function (id, text, cls) {
        var node = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!node) return;
        node.textContent = text;
        node.className = "px-4 py-3 font-semibold " + cls;
      };
      var setText = function (id, text) {
        var node = document.getElementById(id);
        if (node) node.textContent = text;
      };
      var calc = function () {
        var drinkersEl = document.getElementById("obcDrinkers");
        var cupsEl = document.getElementById("obcCupsPer");
        var shareEl = document.getElementById("obcPeakShare");
        if (!drinkersEl || !cupsEl || !shareEl) return;
        var drinkers = parseFloat(drinkersEl.value);
        var cupsPer = parseFloat(cupsEl.value);
        var share = parseFloat(shareEl.value);
        if (isNaN(drinkers) || drinkers < 0) drinkers = 0;
        if (isNaN(cupsPer) || cupsPer < 0) cupsPer = 0;
        if (isNaN(share) || share < 0) share = 0;
        if (share > 100) share = 100;
        var daily = drinkers * cupsPer;
        var peak = daily * share / 100;
        setText("obcDaily", String(Math.round(daily)));
        setText("obcPeak", String(Math.round(peak)));
        var machines = [
          { id: "obcVE8", daily: 20, hourly: 15 },
          { id: "obcVWE8", daily: 30, hourly: 20 },
          { id: "obcVGIGA", daily: 100, hourly: 25 }
        ];
        for (var i = 0; i < machines.length; i++) {
          var m = machines[i];
          if (daily > m.daily || peak > m.hourly) {
            setCell(m.id, "Over capacity", "text-burgundy");
          } else if (daily > 0.8 * m.daily || peak > 0.8 * m.hourly) {
            setCell(m.id, "Tight - little headroom", "text-coffee-gold");
          } else {
            setCell(m.id, "Comfortable", "text-forest-green");
          }
        }
      };
      var bind = function () {
        var box = document.getElementById("obc-calc");
        if (!box) return;
        box.addEventListener("input", calc);
        calc();
      };
      if (document.readyState === "loading") {
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", bind);
      } else {
        bind();
      }
    })();
  `}
/>
